article_summaries.title: Summer Camp All Summer Long
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post announcing the summer Community Team event season: Chatty's summer camp in Greenwood Forest (reached by a newly activated Warpstone) and Robbie the Robgoblin's rival camp across the lake, with weekly themed events through Labor Day. It gives the expected in-game event schedule and how to join events via the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Campamento de Verano – Semana de Moda / Summer Camp – Fashion Week)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Summer Camp community event, themed as Fashion Week, with fashion shows and friend activities during the week. It gives the expected in-game event times (Tuesday, Thursday and Friday) and explains how to reach events through the Game Guide calendar and its Go button. The post is undated; it was posted about 11 months before the 2011-06-04 capture.

article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Sports Week
article_summaries.summary: An official Free Realms news post announcing Sports Week, one week of the Summer Camp community event series, with a Snowhill soccer challenge and a sports-themed house party. It gives the schedule of in-game events and explains how to find and teleport to them through the Game Guide calendar. The post is dated only relatively ('1 month, 6 days ago' at capture on 2010-08-13), so its exact date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Campamento de Verano – Semana Deportiva)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Free Realms Summer Camp event, covering its Sports Week theme. It gives the scheduled times for in-game community events and explains how to reach them via the Game Guide calendar. The exact post date is not shown (only 'Posted 10 months, 4 weeks ago' relative to capture), so it is undated.

article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Arts and Crafts Week
article_summaries.summary: A live-game community event post for the Summer Camp season, covering the 'Arts and Crafts Week' theme, which highlights crafting jobs (Blacksmith, Cook), music boomboxes, and house block sculptures. It gives the expected in-game event schedule and explains how to find events through the Game Guide calendar and GO button teleport. The post is dated only relatively ('1 week, 5 days ago') so no absolute date can be confirmed.

article_summaries.title: Campamento de Verano – Semana de Artesanías (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post for the Summer Camp event's 'Crafting Week' theme. It describes the weekly printable event calendar, the in-game event schedule (Pacific Time), and how to reach events through the Game Guide's calendar and Go button. The post is dated only by a relative 'Posted 10 months, 3 weeks ago' stamp, so the exact date is unknown.
